# Cargo registry
> Static snapshot for LLMs. Generation `7c80bc596083516bc725ea06`: 8 packages, 10 versions. Machine-readable inventory: [catalog.json](/generations/7c80bc596083516bc725ea06/catalog.json). Human browser: [index.html](/generations/7c80bc596083516bc725ea06/index.html).

## Registry

- Origin: https://crates.example.test
- Pinned generation: `generations/7c80bc596083516bc725ea06/`
- Inventory: [catalog.json](/generations/7c80bc596083516bc725ea06/catalog.json)
- Browser: [index.html](/generations/7c80bc596083516bc725ea06/index.html)

## Use

Configure Cargo against the sparse index under `current/registry/`:

```toml
[source.crates-io]
replace-with = "stuff"
[source.stuff]
registry = "sparse+https://crates.example.test/current/registry/"
```

Index files live at `current/registry/<shard>` (sharded like the crates.io sparse index; mirrored upstream entries under `current/crates-io/`). Config: [config.json](/generations/7c80bc596083516bc725ea06/registry/config.json). Blobs: `blobs/<sha256>.crate` via the `dl` template. Inventory: [catalog.json](/generations/7c80bc596083516bc725ea06/catalog.json). Browser: [index.html](/generations/7c80bc596083516bc725ea06/index.html). Pin a generation with `current` (`current -> generations/<id>`); immutable snapshots live under `generations/<id>/`.
